summary: SIEM feed s073_single is degraded due to 9.8% duplicate packets (348/3564, threshold 5%). All other checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLANs, encryption) are healthy and meet SIEM requirements (no bidirectional or full payload needed).

findings.root_cause: Overlapping SPAN/mirror sources or aggregation of both sides of the same link without broker deduplication; packet broker is forwarding the same packet twice to the SIEM port.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM wastes ingest, storage and license on duplicate events, inflates EPS/event counts, skews correlation and analytics, and can generate duplicate alerts without improving detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication on feed s073_single to drop identical packets within a short time window before delivery and bring duplicate rate below 5% threshold.
